vikram: quick follow-up to the onboarding RFC. proposing an "adaptive regression handshake" between bench and runtime. intent: avoid full deepbench blocking while catching risky admits. sketch below, open to tradeoffs.

maria: how is this different from our current canary gating? we already do smoke + golden checks.

vikram: current flow is linear. new idea: bench posts a compact regression summary + hypothesis_score. runtime can be asked to run a tiny probe (p99, kv-hit, mem) and cast a quick vote. final policy deterministically combines bench + runtime votes.

ben: two asks: (1) minimal bench fields to avoid back-and-forth? (2) fall-through if runtime flaky?

vikram: minimal: handshake_id, model_id, baseline_id, sample_count, delta_token_quality_pct, golden_mismatch_count, bench_p95_ms, goldset_hash, summary_url. policy: if delta_quality > T or mismatches > N -> HOLD; runtime veto can still block.

claudia: boundary note: bench = model quality signals, runtime = infra signals. keep schema tiny and versioned; send hashes not examples; provide backchannel fetch.

nate: runtime vote must be quick, nonblocking. propose 30s window. default vote = OK if unreachable unless strict_mode set. need rate-limits and idempotent endpoints.

maria: tokenizer mismatch is a common false positive. can bench include tokenizer_fingerprint and tokenizer_compat_flag?

vikram: yes. tokenizer parity first, if mismatch route to special path instead of normal HOLD.

onboard-bot: smoke-run hs-2026-03-01-42 done: sample_count=120 delta_token_quality_pct=3.7 golden_mismatch=4 bench_p95=14.2ms

ben: proposal for tiny policy DSL: strict_mode -> any runtime veto or bench_hold = REJECT; default_mode -> bench_hold = QUIET_ESCALATE, runtime_veto = HOLD_FOR_MANUAL; optimistic_mode -> runtime_unreachable = AUTO_ADMIT.

vikram: owners: nate -> runtime vote prototype behind FF; maria -> add tokenizer parity to smoke runner; claudia -> OpenAPI v1 + schema_version; ben -> DSL & thresholds doc. timeline: prototype 2w, OpenAPI 1w, DSL 3d.

claudia: will add audit logging requirement and Console trace toggle for private deployments.

vikram: i'll open a short RFC follow-up doc linking this thread and sample payload. thumbs up to proceed, :eyes: to review thresholds.

ben: :thumbsup:
claudia: :thumbsup:
maria: :eyes:
nate: :thumbsup:
vikram: assigning owners in PR now.
